I'm not going to fall for that―|Sabine Wren and the stormtrooper|}} This '''stormtrooper''' was a member of the [[Stormtrooper Corps]] that was stationed on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Lothal]] four [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]]. He and several other troopers were escorting [[264]], a courier droid, to the [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] [[Lagos (Sentinel-class)|''Lagos'']] when the squad was attacked by [[Sabine Wren]]. Her fellow [[Spectres|Spectre]] [[Garazeb Orrelios]] came up behind them and bashed him and another trooper's heads together. ==Behind the scenes== This stormtrooper was voiced by [[Steve Blum]]. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Rebel Resolve}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Lothal Imperial Garrison members]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]]
